difficulty_reason: The result extends the invariant-Ricci construction to connected sums with any homotopy seven-sphere, including exotic ones. The author constructs principal bundles via twisted suspensions, proves quotient families remain pairwise nondiffeomorphic after connected sums, and uses core-metric gluing to obtain invariant positive Ricci metrics on the total spaces. The new suspension and cancellation argument is retained together with its source-local base-family construction; individual supporting lemmas and the immediate corollary are not counted separately.
